canonical_project: China Construction Bank (CCB) Gui'an Data Center
notes: CCB data center & big-data application demonstration base to land in Guiyang/Gui'an with reported total investment RMB 32.3 bn (includes group subsidiary park development); CCB also pushing subsidiaries into Gui'an and channeling overseas funds via CCB International. No rack/MW disclosed; capacity 646 MW is investment-derived (32.3 x 2 MW/100 mn RMB) and includes non-DC development - treat as upper-bound proxy.
